fact: Expertise France's posting of 8 August 2025 says the SAFE project places an international part-time expert to advise the tax directorate (DGID) and the finance ministry's IT directorate (DSI) on running IT projects and managing technical providers, and contracts an external software publisher to develop and deploy the e-TAX system.
title: SAFE RCA - Expertise Perlée Suivi de la Digitalisation (H/F)
